description: For warranty repair, this estimate request form records reported defect, diagnostic plan, coverage, access, parts, repair method, collateral restoration, and scheduling. Its supporting evidence includes intake photos, installation record, diagnostic readings, removed-part findings, repair photos, and functional test.

title: Warranty Repair Estimate Request Form
use_case: Use the estimate request form during trade warranty repair dispatch and verification when the warranty repair record must identify original work order, installed component, location, completion date, warranty term, customer, and prior callbacks. Complete the applicable handoff for repair verification, customer acceptance, coverage disposition, recurrence action, costs, and warranty-record update.
